title: fraxinus caroliniana var. pubescens
intro: Fraxinus caroliniana var. pubescens, commonly known as the Carolina ash or southeastern ash, is a deciduous tree native to the southeastern United States. It is valued for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in the treatment of wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Fraxinus caroliniana var. pubescens include analgesic and antiseptic properties, making it useful in soothing pain and preventing the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
